correctness.rationale: Singleton characteristic functions belong to a Hausdorff ample Steinberg algebra exactly when the corresponding isotropy arrows are open; etaleness makes this equivalent to isolation of the unit. The corner and graded-obstruction arguments follow from support and homogeneous invertibility.

originality.rationale: Qualified narrowly and to the best of our knowledge. General isotropy induction and isolated-unit corner results are prior art; the claim is the sharp correction of arXiv:2609.20230v1, its explicit two-loop counterexample, and the finite-dimensional graded periodicity obstruction. Older implicit formulations remain a residual risk.

value.rationale: The correction applies at the foundational embedding used throughout the source paper's isotropy-restriction section, gives the exact missing topological hypothesis, and supplies the correct corner/fiber boundary together with a structural graded consequence.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, formal verification, or a guarantee of first discovery.
